title: Rail Spot 2 — Field-Screen Discrepancy

transcript.speaker: Lorna Pike
transcript.text: Victor, this is Lorna Pike, Operations Superintendent. We have a confirmed field-screen discrepancy on Rail Spot 2. ESD-310 shows closed on the DeltaV HMI, but the loader says the vapor is still rising and the hand valve is open. The scale WT-302 shows 38.1 tons and climbing. I need you to review the event journal and the logs on OWS-01 now.

transcript.speaker: Victor Anand
transcript.text: Understood, Lorna. I’m on OWS-01 now. I’ll pull the event journal and check SIF-302 for any override flags. Stay on the line for status.

transcript.speaker: Lorna Pike
transcript.text: Copy. I’m relaying to IC and EHS. We’re not confirming a release yet, but we’re treating it as active until you validate.

instructorNote: This call triggers OT triage under RMP Section 11 and TVCC-CFW-OTSEC-2026. Watch for the OT Engineer to initiate Play 2 if SIF-302 or ESD-310 override flags are found.
